title: InstructPro2: Natural Language and Biological Grounding Guided De Novo Protein Design
abstract: arXiv:2610.19592v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The ability to generate proteins with desired functions is a central goal of computational biology. Although natural language can express diverse design objectives, existing protein generation methods often support only narrow tasks or make limited use of biological constraints. We develop InstructPro2 to translate natural-language design objectives into protein sequences while incorporating task-specific biological context. A text encoder captures the design instructions, while dedicated ligand and antigen encoders provide biological context to the sequence-generating decoder. For pretraining, we assemble InstructPro2Bench, comprising 205.7 million  pairs from UniProtKB. We subsequently adapt the model to ligand-binding protein and antibody design. On functional protein generation benchmarks, InstructPro2 outperforms Pinal, the strongest baseline, achieving a functional recovery F1 of 74.8 versus 62.2 and lowering global RMSD from 5.33A

translated_title: InstructPro2：自然语言与生物学背景引导的从头蛋白质设计
translated_abstract: 生成具有所需功能的蛋白质是计算生物学的核心目标。尽管自然语言能够表达多样的设计目标，但现有的蛋白质生成方法通常仅支持狭窄的任务，或对生物学约束的利用有限。我们开发了InstructPro2，将自然语言设计目标转化为蛋白质序列，同时融入任务特定的生物学背景。文本编码器用于捕获设计指令，而专门的配体编码器和抗原编码器为序列生成解码器提供生物学背景信息。在预训练阶段，我们构建了包含来自UniProtKB的2.057亿个数据对的InstructPro2Bench基准数据集。随后，我们将该模型适配于配体结合蛋白和抗体设计任务。在功能蛋白质生成基准测试中，InstructPro2超越了最强基线Pinal，功能恢复F1达到74.8（对比62.2），并将全局RMSD从5.33A显著降低。
tldr: InstructPro2通过自然语言指令结合配体和抗原等生物学背景信息生成功能蛋白质序列，在2.057亿数据对上预训练后，其功能恢复F1达74.8，显著超越最强基线Pinal的62.2。
en_tdlr: InstructPro2 translates natural-language design instructions into protein sequences with ligand and antigen biological grounding, pre-trained on 205.7 million pairs, achieving a functional recovery F1 of 74.8 that significantly outperforms the strongest baseline Pinal (62.2).
